meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析 Git 代码变更，找出修改的文件、受影响的组件和架构层，并评估风险。最后生成一个可视化用的差异覆盖文件。
howto.when: 当你需要理解 Git 差异或拉取请求中的代码变更时，可以要求 Claude 分析。

say.text: 分析当前分支的代码变更，告诉我哪些组件受影响。
say.note: Claude 会执行 git diff 并查询知识图谱。

say.text: 帮我看看这个 PR 的改动有什么风险。
say.note: Claude 会分析 PR 的差异并给出风险评估。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes Git diffs to identify changed files, affected components, and architectural layers, then assesses risks. It also writes a diff overlay file for visualization.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand code changes from a Git diff or pull request, ask Claude to analyze.

say_en.text: Analyze the current branch changes and tell me which components are affected.
say_en.note: Claude will run git diff and query the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Review this PR's changes and assess the risks.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the PR diff and provide risk assessment.
